observation.command:
export PATH=$PATH:/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools
echo "---APK LABEL---"
/opt/android-sdk/build-tools/36.0.0/aapt dump badging /workspace/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-ni-release.apk 2>/dev/null | grep -E "application-label:|launchable-activity"
echo "---VIEW HIERARCHY (top app)---"
adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/hi.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 && adb shell cat /sdcard/hi.xml 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'class="[^"]*FlutterView[^"]*"|resource-id="[^"]*flutter[^"]*"' | head -5
echo "---Window focus / resumed---"
adb shell dumpsys window 2>/dev/null | grep -E "mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp" | head -3
